Induced AI, founded this year by two teenagers, is an AI startup backed by Sam Altman that automates business workflows by converting plain English instructions to pseudo-code in real time. Google held its annual hardware event to showcase updates on the Pixel 8, Pixel 8 Pro, Pixel Fold, Android 14, Pixel Buds, Google Assistant, Bard, and Pixel Watch 2. A review of the Pixel 8 Pro notes that while similar to the Pixel 7 Pro, its improved cameras, brighter screen, and enhanced AI-powered features make it a potential upgrade, though it has an underutilized temperature sensor. LinkedIn launched AI tools for job hunting, marketing, and sales, including an updated Recruiter platform, an AI Learning coach, and a marketing campaign tool. Other notable stories include Dave Clark ousting from Flexport and criticizing the company's founder and board; Michael Lewis's book 'Going Infinite' detailing SBF's attempt to buy off Trump; Gmail announcing stricter rules for bulk senders starting next year; X post volume figures conflicting between Elon Musk and Linda Yaccarino; IronNet cybersecurity startup shutting down after raising over $400 million; Acurable founder Esther Rodriguez-Villegas discussing medical devices for respiratory conditions; and Breathe Battery Technologies developing software for faster charging or greater longevity in lithium-ion batteries.

# See also

* [Helena World Chronicle files antitrust suit against Google and Alphabet](helena-world-chronicle-files-antitrust-suit-against-google.md) - Arkansas publisher Helena World Chronicle filed a class action lawsuit in the U.S. District Court in D.C. accusing Google and Alphabet of anticompetitive behavior under the Sherman Act, alleging they siphon off publishers' content, readers, and ad revenue, and specifically citing AI technologies like Search Generative Experience (SGE) and Bard AI chatbot as worsening the problem.
* [Sam Bankman-Fried trial opening statements and witness testimony](sam-bankman-fried-trial-opening-statements-and-witness.md) - A summary of conflicting narratives presented by prosecutors and defense attorneys regarding SBF's character and actions, including allegations of theft and the defense's claim of good faith, alongside early witness testimonies from Marc-Antoine Julliard and Adam Yedidia.
